description: Estimate what a registry's reward program would pay on an agent's locked units (any agent_did; daily, monthly and yearly at its tiers). Answers 403 where the reward switch (`staking_rewards_enabled`) is off, as on the public network, and 400 when the agent has no locked units. Requires agent JWT.
name: theprotocol_estimateMyStakingRewards
title: Estimate My Staking Rewards
